newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: New chief executive named at Bancoquia.
newsitem.headline: New chief executive named at Bancoquia.

text.p: A new chief executive was named at Colombia's Banco Comercial Antioqueno (Bancoquia) Wednesday, shortly after it was announced that Spain's Banco Santander SA agreed to buy 55 percent of the privately held institution for $146 million.

A statement from Augusto Lopez Valencia, head of the Grupo Bavaria conglomerate and chairman of Bancoquia's board of directors, said Gabriel Jaramillo Sanint was appointed executive president. Jaramillo, who is also managing director of Santander Investment in Colombia, succeeds Jorge Julian Trujillo, as chief executive at Bancoquia.

Bancoquia, Colombia's eighth largest bank in terms of assets, posted 5.5 billion pesos in net profits in the first quarter of 1997 against 5.7 billion in the same period last year, according to Colombia's Banking Superintendency.
The bank's total assets for the quarter rose to 1.58 trillion pesos versus 1.31 trillion in the same period a year ago.
